content: उत्कर {%a.%} (-रा, -री|{%f.%}) [कॄ-अप्] That which piles or throws up or raises. .{@-रः@} .²1 A heap, multitude; नखांशूत्करः <ls>Ki. 8. 5</ls>. .²2 A pile, stack. .²3 Rubbish, what is thrown up (मूषिकोत्कर) <ls>Mk. 3</ls>. .²4 A bunch (as of flowers); पादपान्कुसुमोत्करान् <ls>Rām. 2. 55. 30</ls>; <ls>Bhāg. 7. 10. 69</ls>.
